audit_scope: read-only generic synthetic discovery runner foundation

passing_contracts: eligible Cartesian parameter cells are complete
all SchemaViolation-invalid candidates are retained without a winner
valid full positive-definite covariance whitening succeeds
zero-variance and near-null covariance support violations are rejected
result hash body contains no native floats and canonical parameter hashing rejects floats
eligible replay-ledger admission/completion entries are adjacent and identity-bound

blockers.counterexample: Two exact zero-RMSE candidates with distinct_gap=0 are assigned one lexicographic winner and distinct=true; a single valid candidate with no comparator is also marked PROMISING_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE and distinct=true.
blockers.impact: Tie membership, truth recovery, and distinct discovery can be decided by lexical order or by absence of any comparator.

blockers.counterexample: An executable cluster-only binding with registered parameter cells scale.one and scale.two in a galaxy scenario emits one blocked cell with parameter_cell_id=null and one ledger entry, not two exact blocked matrix cells.
blockers.impact: The declared scenario x binding x parameter-cell matrix and replay ledger are incomplete for scenario-ineligible executable formulas.

blockers.counterexample: truth_formula_by_scenario='not-a-candidate' is accepted and scored; the winning registered formula is then reported with truth_recovered=false rather than rejecting the invalid truth map.
blockers.impact: Recovery counts can be generated from a truth identity absent from the candidate registry.

blockers.counterexample: SyntheticSuiteRelease(response_calibrated=true) is accepted by the function documented as response-blind.
blockers.impact: The runner does not enforce its response-blind claim at the release boundary.

blockers.counterexample: A diagonal covariance whose UncertaintyRef applies_to_element_id is source.vector.acceleration is accepted to whiten response.vector.acceleration and produces a score.
blockers.impact: A source uncertainty can be silently substituted for the response uncertainty.

blockers.counterexample: An adapter OSError('audit-adapter-io-failure') escapes run_discovery_matrix instead of producing NUMERICAL_INVALID cells.
blockers.impact: One adapter failure can abort the matrix, violating retain-every-failure behavior.
